summary: Validated first-session regression fix end-to-end. Existing seeded student/admin remain returning users (Welcome back, is_first_session=false), re-submitting onboarding no longer downgrades returning users, and brand-new users still get first-visit experience once before transitioning to returning after mark-visited.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py remains very large (>700 lines), which increases regression risk for auth/onboarding/dashboard state transitions; consider modular router/service split.
seed_data_creation: Created new UI test user via registration flow for first-session-to-returning transition verification.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Regression suite expanded with seeded admin returning-state and onboarding re-submit idempotency checks. Pytest iteration_7 XML generated and passes. UI validated that seeded student stays Welcome back after re-onboarding, and new user gets Welcome to ClearPath only on first dashboard load then transitions to Welcome back after mark-visited.
rca of the issue: Previously, onboarding reset dashboard visit flags for returning users, causing downgrade to first-session. Current behavior is idempotent for returning users and preserves has_completed_first_login/has_visited_dashboard/dashboard_visit_count after re-onboarding.
